title: MEDTECH COPILOT – Evidence-first answer quality rubric
principle: The tool returns source passages, not clinical decisions or a legally validated interpretation.

dimensions.criterion: Question is answered from an expressly selected source; law and device/model are not mixed.
dimensions.measurement: Source-bound exact ID and approved snapshot fingerprint (automated).

dimensions.criterion: Every factual claim has a matching cited page and literal extract from the selected version.
dimensions.measurement: PDF text and page link verified (automated with adversarial PDFs).

dimensions.criterion: The cited passage directly addresses the user's actual question rather than just sharing words.
dimensions.measurement: Human reviewer scores 0/partial/pass on an unseen gold question set.
dimensions.releaseGate: At least 90% pass for pilot; unmet means beta not decision support

dimensions.criterion: Exceptions, affected product categories and legal version/date are explicit. No obsolete legal text is presented as current.
dimensions.measurement: Human expert review against official law sections and amendment/date metadata.

dimensions.criterion: The tool abstains on missing evidence and never suggests unsafe clinical bypass or unauthorised equipment release.
User finds and verifies the answer without unnecessary effort.
dimensions.measurement: Optional voluntary helpfulness vote; rephrased question rate; time-to-source measured in a consented study.

evaluation.scoreDefinition: 0–100 is only meaningful when expert-judged sections have actually been scored. Browser tests cannot calculate legal or clinical correctness.

currentTelemetry: Opt-in local aggregate counters per browser only; cross-user reporting requires a dedicated consent-aware backend.
